does: Prepares the AI helpers for one decision request: gathers the level's characters and items with their transforms and the on-damage spells of items into the helper's working state.

evidence.says: queries over ls::TransformComponent, ls::LevelComponent, esv::Item and esv::spell::OnDamageSpellsComponent filling the helper's arrays

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 2 places, the request function at code:unplaced::UpdateCombatAiRequest and one at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x3615CA0, each paired with UnprepareRequest at the same count (308 and 14)
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes
the macOS build's symbols hold this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
